title: 2110 Prairie's gable flush with its front, its loggia arches deep
items: 2110 Prairie's front now runs straight up into its tall gable, as both of its photographs show it, with no heavy ledge across the front; a plain stone pier rises at the north corner and nothing stands over the south one; the five loggia windows sit deep in their arches between free-standing columns under a carved band; and the gable's carved panel is carved edge to edge. The house now matches both of its photographs.
